# Official disclosure fixtures

These twenty-four inert HTML files contain selected official-text excerpts from the SEC documents identified in `scripts/source_reviews/company_observations.json`: twelve earnings exhibits and twelve 10-Qs (four per pilot issuer). Retrieved through the shared SEC client and verified filing-event relationships on 2026-09-22. The wrappers are fixture markup, not original exhibit layout; no active content is included.

The registry records exact official URL, accession, exhibit or periodic-filing relationship, original normalized document hash, reviewed passage hash, supporting contexts and extraction recipe. Source text is whitespace-normalized using `company_evidence.Structure`; numeric disclosures and punctuation are preserved. Tests require extracted observations to match the published feed. Fixture publication is explicitly offline and never promoted to live data.

Coverage now includes guidance, operating KPIs and business mix. The original 63 guidance/KPI observations remain unchanged. The 124 business-mix observations preserve reportable-segment versus market-platform/revenue-category classifications, source-specific historical/recast values and Corporate/Other reconciliation. Only complete reconciled groups can publish.

See `docs/internal/company-segments-2026-09-22/report.md` and the earlier company-observations report for historical coverage, source/review boundaries and exclusions. Rename-only test cases are explicitly synthetic; the NVIDIA reorganizations/recasts and issuer tables are actual primary-source fixtures.

Capital coverage adds 189 observations: 184 inline-XBRL facts, two untagged SoFi Bank capital ratios and three funding-context passages. The prior 187 observations remain unchanged. Inline fixtures retain original context/unit XML and numeric fact attributes, scale, sign and rendered text; inner presentational markup is flattened. Overlapping reviewed passages are merged in source order so fixture duplication cannot fabricate ambiguous evidence. Production extraction parses complete SEC documents, selects exact concept/entity/period/unit/dimensions, and checks the canonical fact against its pinned SHA-256. Conflicting numeric duplicates and unsupported transforms fail closed.

Actual historical cases include CrowdStrike's July 2026 4-for-1 split and its fiscal-2026 correction of SBC timing. Original and issuer-revised observations are both retained. Missing repurchase facts are not zeroes; YTD cash payments are not quarter flows or authorizations. See `docs/internal/company-capital-2026-09-22/report.md` for definitions and limitations.
